Open-label sulforaphane in fragile-X tremor ataxia with gait and motor ratings; no cooked kale or PD-specific outcome. Prior associated primary paper is already catalogued.
Dried dill aerial-parts capsule versus placebo for nodule size and thyroid measures. Fine needle aspiration is the diagnostic procedure. No swallowing outcome or fresh culinary dill.
PD/RBD genomic biobank includes polysomnography, RBD and dyskinesia but intervention is sequencing, no assigned kale or dietary exposure.
Infant probiotic versus sunflower oil vehicle, GI outcomes; no assigned culinary herb or PD endpoint.

Alzheimer behavioral and social cognition questionnaires, no assigned culinary exposure or Parkinson apathy intervention.
Sulforaphane versus placebo for schizophrenia cognition and movement side-effect scales; isolated constituent, not steamed kale leaves or PD.
Multicomponent traditional preparation includes white mustard seed and oils for dysmenorrhea; pain ratings in non-PD population cannot isolate culinary mustard effects.
Single-person intermittent fasting, varied diet, supplement, exercise and wearables, metabolic markers; no ingredient-specific randomized PD outcome.
Mixed spice and vegetable rice versus unspiced meal; postprandial metabolic and inflammatory markers, no cilantro-only or PD apathy test.
Longitudinal psychiatric cohort assesses social withdrawal, cognition and biological sampling; no assigned culinary herb or Parkinson apathy treatment.
Chandrakanthi Choornam in milk for oligospermia, sperm endpoints; no PD salivation or specified pinto intervention.
Thymoquinone with metformin for polycystic ovary syndrome; metabolic and reproductive outcomes rather than named culinary plant or PD symptom.
Pregnancy choline versus combined rice-bran/pumpkin-seed oil placebo, infant orienting and sensory-gating outcomes; oil grade unspecified, two oils, no PD falls or oil-free contrast.
Creatine plus curcumin and basic nutrition in gastrointestinal cancer cachexia, not isolated culinary herb or PD facial-expression outcome.

Topical multi-agent analgesic compounding study measures pain, including capsaicin and menthol; not ingested culinary spice or PD motor endpoints.
